sources.excerpt: by CostaLab Website Link Model Number or Name: Dual Drive Distortion Overdrive Circuit Type: Analog Original Price: $199 Excellent Used Price: $155 Year Released: 2015 Alternate Version(s) No Alternate Versions Listed The Dual Drive represents the state of the art of overdrive sound. Built inspired by a must like the TS808, it also offers modern and more suitable solutions for today’s music. The result is a pedal that allows you to have all the nuances of overdrive in a single box, from the sound of the late 70s to the most modern of today. In addition to the classic power switch, the Dual Drive features a second switch that enables the MORE DRIVE function. With this function, a second gain circuit is activated that can reach higher levels of overdrive. The first gain stage offers a light overdrive sound that enhances the dynamics and expressiveness of the guitarist also using humbucker pickups.
